question: The number of toys manufactured by a machine in 2018 was 25,000, which increased by 20% in 2019. In 2020, the production was hindered by strike and it fell by 15%. How many total toys were manufactured in three years by the machine?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

2018 production = 25000

2019 production = 25000 × 1.20 = 30000

2020 production = 30000 × 0.85 = 25500

Total = 25000 + 30000 + 25500 = 80500

**∴ The correct answer is 80500.**
